what: pose error of a classical depth-camera cube estimator in the v3.2 cell (docs/pose_error.md)

overhead.note: fixed, 1.5 m above the bench over the robot base, looking down; ToF narrow-mode resolution and field of view (640 x 576, 65 deg vertical)

station_b.note: fixed near the machine at tower B, 0.6 m from the station, 21 deg from vertical

hover_b.note: straight down from 0.55 m above tower B: a wrist camera with the hand paused above the station (arm at home in the evaluation)

low.note: assumed good sensor: sigma = 1 mm at 1 m (2.3 mm at 1.5 m), 0.5 % dropout, 10 % of edge pixels dropped

medium.note: Kinect v1 axial noise model (Nguyen, Izadi and Lovell 2012): sigma = 1.2 mm + 1.9 mm (z - 0.4 m)^2, 3.5 mm at 1.5 m; 2 % dropout, 30 % of edge pixels dropped

high.note: RealSense D435 depth RMS formula (Intel): sigma = 3.6 mm z^2, 8 mm at 1.5 m; 5 % dropout, 50 % of edge pixels dropped

definitions.visible: the stack's top cube shows >= 25 px in the segmentation render, and does not touch the image border
definitions.detected: some cluster's top face is mostly that cube (segmentation, identity only)
definitions.merged: the cluster also holds >= 15 px of another stack
definitions.xy_mm: distance between estimated and true top-face centre, detected cubes
